title: Multi-Agent Collaboration via Evolving Orchestration
authors: Yufan Dang; Chen Qian; Xueheng Luo; Jingru Fan; Zihao Xie; Ruijie Shi; Weize Chen; Cheng Yang; Xiaoyin Che; Ye Tian; Xuantang Xiong; Lei Han; et al.
venue_full: Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems 2025
research_focus: Agentic / Workflow serving, Reasoning / Test-time scaling

problem_statement.en: Existing multi-agent LLM systems rely on static, hand-designed collaboration topologies that neither adapt to evolving per-task conditions nor control computational cost. The paper asks how to dynamically orchestrate a pool of heterogeneous agents on the fly so that collective reasoning is both effective and resource-efficient.
problem_statement.zh: 現有的 multi-agent LLM 系統依賴靜態、人工設計的協作拓撲,既無法因應各任務隨情境演變的條件進行調適,亦無法控制計算成本。本文探討如何即時動態地編排一組異質 agent,使集體推理同時兼顧有效性與資源效率。

key_innovation.en: A centralized orchestrator ("puppeteer") LLM that, at each reasoning step, selects which agent ("puppet") to activate; its selection policy is trained by REINFORCE on a cost-penalized task-outcome reward, so the executed sequence "unfolds" into a per-instance directed graph (trees/cycles) instead of searching a fixed topology space.
key_innovation.zh: 一個中央化的編排器(orchestrator,即「puppeteer」)LLM,於每一推理步驟選擇要啟用哪一個 agent(即「puppet」);其選擇 policy 以 REINFORCE 在具成本懲罰的任務結果 reward 上訓練,使得所執行的序列「展開」為各實例的有向圖(樹狀或含環結構),而非在固定的拓撲空間中搜尋。

baselines_compared: Self-Refine, AFlow, MacNet, EvoAgent, Pure single models, Puppeteer-Mono

key_improvements.en: Titan avg 0.7731 evolved vs 0.6893 init (best baseline AFlow 0.6899); cost falls as accuracy rises during RL.
key_improvements.zh: Titan 子空間演化後平均 0.7731 對初始 0.6893(最佳基線 AFlow 0.6899);RL 過程中成本隨準確率上升而下降。

structure_space: Operator / node graph, Edge topology (spatial), Temporal / cross-round edges, Termination / depth
decision_mechanism: Policy gradient / REINFORCE, LLM on-the-fly orchestration

agent_scenario.en: A single centralized orchestrator (puppeteer) governs a pool of 13 candidate agents (5 tool-use: read_file, search_arxiv, search_bing, access_website, run_python; 8 reasoning-pattern: reasoning, critique, reflect, question, summarize, conclude, modify, planning), each instantiable on multiple LLM backbones. At each step the orchestrator activates exactly one agent conditioned on the global system state and the task; the sequence of activations forms a directed reasoning graph (trees/graphs/cycles). Two backbone regimes are tested: a "Mimas" subspace of smaller models and a "Titan" subspace of large models, plus a homogeneous single-model variant (Puppeteer-Mono) versus the heterogeneous multi-model Puppeteer. It is a general-purpose reasoning setting spanning math, multiple-choice, software, and generation. Default protocol: episode length 4, up to 3 parallel explorations.
agent_scenario.zh: 單一中央化編排器(puppeteer)統理由 13 個候選 agent 構成的資源池(5 個工具使用型:read_file、search_arxiv、search_bing、access_website、run_python;8 個推理模式型:reasoning、critique、reflect、question、summarize、conclude、modify、planning),每個 agent 皆可於多種 LLM backbone 上實例化。於每一步驟,編排器依全域系統狀態與任務,恰啟用一個 agent;啟用序列構成一有向推理圖(樹狀、圖狀或含環結構)。測試兩種 backbone 情境:由較小模型組成的「Mimas」子空間與由大型模型組成的「Titan」子空間,並另設同質的單一模型變體(Puppeteer-Mono)以對比異質的多模型 Puppeteer。此為橫跨數學、多選題、軟體與生成的通用推理設定。預設協定:episode 長度為 4,最多 3 條平行探索。
